name: DunSocial API
description:
PAT-safe REST surface for scheduling and publishing social posts,
managing drafts, media, memory, and workspace personalization.

Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (session or personal
access token). Workspace-scoped routes also need `X-Workspace-Id`.

Facebook Pages (`providerName: Facebook`) are limited beta: Page feed
text, one link, or photos (63,206 characters, images only). There is no
`metadata.facebook` block. Connect the Page in the DunSocial app.

Session-only routes (AI, billing, team admin, webhook endpoint CRUD,
CLI token admin) are omitted from this document.
